correctness.rationale: The exact local Rule-18 truth table identifies every produced one as one endpoint of a zero-run of length at least two between input ones. Each such run supplies exactly two endpoints, forcing a nonempty alternating class of zero gaps. Replacing paired arcs by input zeros and interpair arcs by input ones realizes every allowed state, including n=1 and n=2. Inclusion–exclusion on indexed marked one positions yields the fixed-weight binomial formula, and independent cycle-incidence generating functions give the logarithmic-derivative identity. Factorization of its denominators proves the asymptotic. Standalone verify.py exhaustively independently checks all 2^n inputs and all 2^n output candidates for each n<=18 and recurrence coefficients to n=70, printing VERIFY_OK; finite checks are corroboration only.

value.rationale: The exact one-step image is the natural reachable-output invariant of a classical nonlinear cellular automaton. The two alternating-gap test gives an O(n)-time deterministic recognition criterion and constructive predecessor, while the weight-refined formula gives exact counts in each occupation sector and the rational generating function fixes all finite-ring image sizes and exponential information loss. The statement is all-length, addresses a distinct natural structural gap beyond finite tables, and does not merely rename standard computability.
